info.title: Dojo Course API
info.description: Browse and download courses, read learning metrics, and record course lifecycle events.

tags.name: Courses
tags.description: The catalog: listings, search, each course's files and its learning metrics.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Lifecycle events the CLI records: installs, starts, kata completions and finishes.

get.description: Check whether the Course API is available.
Read course descriptions, authors, languages and repository links without the full metrics payload.
Read the complete marketplace catalog, including profiles, lifecycle metrics and trending rank.
Browse courses by lifetime installs, installs over the last seven days, or the change in installs since yesterday. Page numbers start at zero.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Ranking to use. The hot view also includes installsYesterday and change.

get.description: Find courses by name, source, description, author, language, framework or tags.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text, with at least two non-whitespace characters.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Restrict results to this course owner.

get.description: Browse owners and their most installed course, along with each owner's course catalog.
Read installs, starts, completions, progress by kata and weekly activity for one course.

Read the security checks on a course: Dojo's own on every new snapshot, then Cisco's skill-scanner. A fail stops the CLI from installing the course; a warn asks first. Courses without audits return 404.

status.description: A trial course installs by its repository but isn't in the catalog yet.

get.description: Read the course's content hash and files. Unknown courses return 404.

post.description: Record an install, start, kata completion or finish. Duplicate events are accepted without being counted twice. An installed event can register a public GitHub source when source.repository matches courseId.

instanceId.description: Random identifier for the local project; do not send names, email addresses or file contents.

occurredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; defaults to the server time.
